sample_1.prompt: A man in business attire leaning toward a female colleague after a presentation, smiling warmly and saying something kind. She looks pleasantly surprised and touched, holding her presentation clicker. A projected slide is visible in the softly blurred background. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm office tones, cinematic composition.

sample_2.prompt: An elegant woman at a fine dining restaurant looking across the table toward the open kitchen, gesturing appreciatively toward a chef who smiles back with pride. A beautifully plated dish sits before her. Candlelight flickers on white tablecloths. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, rich amber tones, cinematic composition.

sample_3.prompt: A young woman walking down a sunny street, face breaking into a wide, radiant smile after receiving an unexpected kind word from a passing acquaintance. Her eyes light up with delight. Warm golden hour sunlight fills the scene. Photorealistic style, shallow depth of field, warm golden tones, candid cinematic composition.
